summary: Verified the TokenGate UX-clarity fix in frontend/src/App.js and re-ran full regression suite. All required copy changes render correctly: intro text mentions 'API_ACCESS_TOKEN' + "backend's .env file", footer note clarifies it's not the Alpaca key/secret, and the wrong-token error message explicitly says 'API_ACCESS_TOKEN from backend/.env - not your Alpaca API key/secret.' Verified via Playwright: entering the Alpaca key (PKRBZGHKVX2SGHWQZZVRJLXRPN) as site token correctly shows the new error and stays on the gate; entering the correct API_ACCESS_TOKEN unlocks the app (dashboard + navbar visible) and persists across reload via localStorage key momentumx_api_token. Backend curl regression: GET /api/settings -> 401 no header, 401 with Alpaca key as bearer (correct rejection), 200 with correct API_ACCESS_TOKEN. GET /api/account returns real Alpaca paper data (account_number PA30RVV1A2DM, portfolio_value $2603.95, no crash). Full pytest suite: 41/41 passed (16 test_auto_trader_exit_logic.py + 25 test_security_and_trading.py) - note had to export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL manually since it's not set in backend shell env by default, otherwise test_security_and_trading.py fails collection (pre-existing test-runner environment quirk, not a code bug).

minor.issue: Test file reads os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL') but this var is not exported in the backend shell/pytest environment by default, causing AttributeError on collection unless manually exported before running pytest. Not a production bug, but worth adding a conftest.py fallback (e.g. load from frontend/.env) so future test runs don't silently skip this suite.

action_items: (Optional, minor) Add a conftest.py fallback to load REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env if not present in os.environ, so test_security_and_trading.py doesn't fail collection when run in a fresh shell without manual export.
critical_code_review_comments: TokenGate copy changes in App.js (lines 48-51 intro, 74-77 footer, 36 error message) exactly match the requested UX fix text, all data-testid attributes present and correctly wired (token-gate-screen, token-gate-input, token-gate-submit-button, token-gate-error).

Auth behavior unchanged and correct: Alpaca key is correctly rejected as site token (401), confirming broker credentials cannot bypass site auth - this was already correct pre-fix, only messaging changed.
get_account() no longer crashes on cash accounts with None daytrading_buying_power - confirmed live via /api/account returning valid data with day_trading_buying_power:0.0, pattern_day_trader:false.
test_credentials: Used API_ACCESS_TOKEN and ALPACA_API_KEY values exactly as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md - both correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: This was a small UX-copy fix verification pass following iteration_2 (Phase1-3) and iteration_3 (Phase4-5), both 100% pass. This pass (iteration_4) also 100% pass - TokenGate messaging fix verified working exactly as specified, no functional auth regression. Real Alpaca paper account (PA30RVV1A2DM) is live and returning real data on dashboard (1 open AAPL position, portfolio value ~$2603). No open bugs; only a minor test-environment note about exporting REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before running pytest for test_security_and_trading.py.
rca of the issue: N/A - this was a verification-only pass confirming the UX fix; no bugs found. The reported 'bug' (Alpaca key rejected as site token) was never a real bug - it was correct-by-design behavior, and the fix only improves clarifying copy to prevent user confusion.
